name: 33848-loradecode-qwen3moe30b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, fully_sharded_loras off (the default).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, bounded at 40 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% by completion, leaving 32 measured.
workload: GuideLLM `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, no tools: fixed-shape random-token requests, 1580 prompt tokens and exactly 600 output tokens, both pinned min=max and the output exact (`max_tokens=600` with `ignore_eos=True`). `request_format: plain`, so no chat template is applied and the wire prompt is the declared 1580. Greedy (temperature 0.0).
purpose: A long-form drafting assistant on one GPU, generating 600-token replies one request at a time from a mixture-of-experts model.
launch:
# Launch config for 33848-loradecode-qwen3moe30b-1gpu: one H100 serving a 128-expert sparse-MoE
# model with a single LoRA adapter, one request at a time. Every key goes into AsyncEngineArgs;
# the adapter itself is named client-side, because `--lora-modules` is an API-server argument.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
enable-lora: true
max-loras: 8
max-lora-rank: 8
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
